output.why: Increasing the COT/DOT waste water transfer pump capacity from 2 m3/hr to 5 m3/hr reduces the retention/pumping time of the 1 m3 collection sump (E1C) from 30 minutes to 12 minutes, and yields a velocity of ~0.71 m/s in the 50 NB discharge line (well below the 2.4 m/s limit). However, the pump motor rating, head calculation for the 144 m discharge line, and inflow rate to sump E1C to prevent frequent pump cycling are not yet specified and must be verified during detailed engineering.
